title: Vercel Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs and What Changed

facts.fact: Vercel's own pricing page lists the v0 Plus plan at $30 per user per month, shown struck through from $90, with $30 monthly credits and $2 daily login credits.
facts.quote: | **Plus** | $30 (shown struck from $90) | per user per month | $30 monthly credits + $2 daily login credits |

facts.fact: Vercel's v0 Business plan is listed at $100 per user per month, with $30 monthly credits, $2 daily credits, and team features.
facts.quote: | **Business** | $100 | per user per month | $30 monthly credits + $2 daily credits; team features |

facts.fact: Vercel's Pro platform plan is listed at $20 per deploying seat per month, including a $20 usage credit and free viewer seats.
facts.unit: USD per deploying seat per month
facts.quote: $20 included usage credit; free viewer seats; Flat Rate CDN default for new teams

facts.fact: Vercel's Flat Rate CDN tiers are listed at $20 per month for 10M requests/50 TB, $100 per month for 50M requests, and $300 per month for 150M requests.
Vercel's Active CPU usage is listed starting at $0.128 per hour.
facts.quote: Active CPU from $0.128/hour

facts.fact: Vercel lists function invocations at $0.60 per 1 million invocations.
facts.quote: function invocations $0.60 per 1M

facts.fact: Vercel lists AI Gateway usage at $3 per 1,000 token requests.
facts.quote: AI Gateway $3 per 1,000 token requests

facts.fact: Vercel lists triggers at $0.95 per 1,000.
facts.quote: triggers $0.95 per 1,000

facts.fact: Vercel lists on-demand CDN usage from $0.15 per GB and $2 per 1 million requests.
facts.unit: USD per GB; USD per 1M requests
facts.quote: On-demand CDN from $0.15/GB and $2 per 1M requests.

facts.fact: Vercel's v0 Mini model is listed at $0.20 per 1M input tokens and $1.20 per 1M output tokens.
facts.quote: v0 Mini $0.20 in / $1.20 out

facts.fact: Vercel's v0 Pro model is listed at $2 per 1M input tokens and $10 per 1M output tokens.
Vercel's v0 Max model is listed at $5 per 1M input tokens and $25 per 1M output tokens.
Vercel's v0 Max Fast model is listed at $10 per 1M input tokens and $50 per 1M output tokens.
facts.quote: v0 Max Fast $10 / $50

facts.fact: Vercel's v0 free tier includes a one-time $5 credit for new users and 7 messages per day.
facts.quote: Free: $5 one-time credits for new users, 7 messages/day.

facts.fact: Vercel's Hobby free tier (non-commercial use) includes 100 GB transfer, 1M edge requests, 4 hours of Active CPU, and 500 AI Gateway requests.
facts.quote: Hobby: free (non-commercial), 100 GB transfer, 1M edge requests, 4 hours Active CPU, 500 AI Gateway requests.

facts.fact: Vercel's Flat Rate CDN became generally available on 8 September 2026 and is the default for new Pro teams.
facts.quote: 8 Sep 2026: Flat Rate CDN generally available, default for new Pro teams, after customers asked for predictable bills.

facts.fact: In September 2025, Vercel restructured Pro to a $20 platform fee with one deploying seat and a $20 usage credit, with free viewer seats.
facts.quote: Sep 2025: Pro restructured to a $20 platform fee with one deploying seat and $20 usage credit; free viewer seats.

facts.fact: Vercel's v0 pricing lets additional credits be purchased and shared across a team.
facts.quote: Additional credits can be purchased and shared across a team.

facts.fact: Per the page's summary of Vercel's pricing, the Pro plan's $20 usage credit applies across resources, and usage is pay-as-you-go and uncapped beyond it.
facts.quote: $20 monthly credit applies across resources; pay as you go uncapped beyond it.

facts.fact: The page states that Vercel's v0 Plus price was displayed at $30 against a struck-through $90 at the time of checking, and that Vercel moved to token-based credits by model in 2025.
facts.quote: 2025: moved to token-based credits by model. Plus displayed at $30 against a struck-through $90 at time of checking.
